resources.string: Pet Diary Sapphire works fully offline. Save a backup file to your phone, an SD card or a USB drive so your records are safe if you change phones.
Saves all pets, records and photos in one .zip file at a place you choose.
Replaces everything in the app with the data from a backup file.
All current pets, records and photos will be replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.
The app will restart to load your restored data.
Could not save the backup file. Try another location.
Could not read the backup file.
This file is not a Pet Diary Sapphire backup.
This backup was made by a newer version of Pet Diary Sapphire. Please update the app first.
